name: Z80-μLM
description: Z80-μLM by HarryR: a tiny language model, 2-bit weights and 16-bit integer maths, in a 40K .COM file. Chat with CHAT, or play GUESS, a game of 20 questions the model answers with YES, NO or MAYBE. Type PLAY (GUESS), or CHAT.
credit: HarryR (github.com/HarryR/z80ai); MIT or Apache-2.0, as you see fit.
